Description.Value:
ONLY THE INJURED FIREWORM: its damaged-skin material goes matte. One number, no art, no code.
The smallest content mod there is. ppcontent.json carries a single "material" row that sets _GlossMapScale on the shipped material ALN_Fireworm_DMG from 1 to 0.15, so a wounded Fireworm stops looking wet. Requires the ContentTool mod, which bakes a private patched copy of the shipped bundle on YOUR machine and serves it in memory; nothing is written into your Phoenix Point installation and switching this mod off puts the shipped material straight back.
